# Item > List row with media, content, and trailing actions. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `item` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/item.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/item.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` - `separator` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/item-knobs`: `itemKnobs`, types `ItemKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/item`: `itemVariants`, `ItemGroup`, `ItemSeparator`, `Item`, `ItemMedia`, `ItemContent`, `ItemTitle`, `ItemDescription`, `ItemActions`, `ItemHeader`, `ItemFooter`, types `ItemVariant`, `ItemProps`, `ItemDescriptionProps`, `ItemFooterProps`, `ItemMediaProps`, `ItemTitleProps`, `ItemGroupProps`, `ItemSeparatorProps`, `ItemActionsProps` ## Composition ### Grouped content rows ```tsx ``` ### Selectable, draggable rows Rows with role="option", "treeitem", "row" or "menuitem" get the hover fill. aria-selected="true" paints the selected fill; set data-dragging on the row being dragged and data-drop-target on the row under it. The host owns selection, keyboard movement and the drag logic. ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { BellIcon, ChevronRightIcon, ImageIcon, MoreHorizontalIcon, RotateCcwIcon, TypeIcon, VideoIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { type KeyboardEvent, useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/dropdown-menu"; import { Item, ItemActions, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemFooter, ItemGroup, ItemHeader, ItemMedia, ItemTitle, } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/item"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; const initialLayers = [ { id: "title", label: "Title card", icon: TypeIcon }, { id: "camera", label: "Camera", icon: VideoIcon }, { id: "background", label: "Background", icon: ImageIcon }, ]; function LayersList() { const [layers, setLayers] = useState(initialLayers); const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState("camera"); const [draggingId, setDraggingId] = useState(null); const [dropTargetId, setDropTargetId] = useState(null); const moveSelection = (event: KeyboardEvent, index: number) => { const step = { ArrowDown: 1, ArrowUp: -1 }[event.key]; const next = step === undefined ? undefined : layers[index + step]; if (!next) return; event.preventDefault(); setSelectedId(next.id); event.currentTarget.parentElement?.querySelector(`[data-layer="${next.id}"]`)?.focus(); }; const dropOn = (targetId: string) => { setLayers((current) => { const dragged = current.find((layer) => layer.id === draggingId); if (!dragged || dragged.id === targetId) return current; const remaining = current.filter((layer) => layer.id !== dragged.id); remaining.splice( remaining.findIndex((layer) => layer.id === targetId), 0, dragged, ); return remaining; }); setDraggingId(null); setDropTargetId(null); }; return ( {layers.map((layer, index) => ( setSelectedId(layer.id)} onKeyDown={(event) => moveSelection(event, index)} onDragStart={() => setDraggingId(layer.id)} onDragEnter={() => setDropTargetId(layer.id)} onDragOver={(event) => event.preventDefault()} onDrop={() => dropOn(layer.id)} onDragEnd={() => { setDraggingId(null); setDropTargetId(null); }} > {layer.label} ))} ); } export function PrimitiveItemExample() { return (

); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `item` - `actions`: `data-show-on-hover` - `content` - `description` - `footer` - `group` - `header` - `media` - `root`: `aria-selected` (`false` | `true`), `data-dragging`, `data-drop-target`, `data-variant` (`default` | `muted` | `outline`) - `separator` - `title` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### item - `--cui-item-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-item-media-icon-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 5)` - `--cui-item-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)` - `--cui-item-current-background`: `var(--active-fill)` - `--cui-item-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-item-selected-background`: `var(--cui-item-current-background)` - `--cui-item-selected-foreground`: `var(--cui-item-foreground)` - `--cui-item-dragging-opacity`: `0.5` - `--cui-item-drop-target-shadow`: `inset 0 0 0 var(--focus-ring-width) var(--primary)` - `--cui-item-hover-border-color`: `var(--_item-border-color)` - `--cui-item-border-width`: `0px` - `--cui-item-active-scale`: `0.99` - `--cui-item-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-item-padding-block`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-item-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-item-description-font-size`: `var(--text-body)` - `--cui-item-description-line-height`: `var(--leading-relaxed)` - `--cui-item-description-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-item-media-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/item - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/item.json
